candidates.requirement: Use the returned uLong from crc32_combine_gen(length) as the scalar third argument to crc32_combine_op.
candidates.target_route: build.sh compiles checksum_fuzzer.c with zlib.h, then links libz.a.
candidates.failure_condition: Both existing generator calls supply two arguments to a one-argument declaration; the operator calls pass a z_crc_t array where uLong is required.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete target has no alternate generator or operator call sequence; compilation stops before fuzz input can select another route.

candidates.requirement: Check dataLen before reading any input byte.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput enters with a zero-byte input and evaluates data[0] before its length guard.
candidates.failure_condition: data[0] reads outside the zero-length input, making the entry's execution invalid.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no earlier guard; the later return cannot prevent the read.
